integrity: Analytical proof includes exact modal reduction and all-delay spectral crossings; finite numerical checks are supplemental and not substitutes for proof. Bibliographic originality requires independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic homogeneous lossy directed cycles of 2, 3 and 4 patches; linearized positive-equilibrium stability only; no nonlinear Hopf, global dynamics, or uniqueness across all network graphs. Literature novelty may have unlocated equivalents.
title: A four-patch directed cycle is the sharp onset of dispersal-induced rotating instability
